data.title: Oliveda International, Inc. (OLVI) Subsidiary Olive Tree People Inc. Introduces ARISTAEOS – the World’s First Combination of Colostrum and Hydroxytyrosol – from Its Andalusian Olive Trees
data.description: A new product called ARISTAEOS, the first of its kind to combine colostrum and hydroxytyrosol, has been introduced by Olive Tree People Inc., a subsidiary of Oliveda International, Inc. This innovative product aims to bring the benefits of both colostrum and hydroxytyrosol to consumers.

data.title: BURFORD CAPITAL ANNOUNCES PRICING OF PRIVATE OFFERING OF SENIOR SECURED NOTES
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Burford Capital Limited, a prominent global finance and asset management company specializing in law, disclosed the pricing details of its private offering. The company priced $300 million in aggregate principal amount of 8.000% senior secured notes.

data.title: Martial Arts Philosophy Meets the Demands of the Modern Workplace
data.description: "Dr. David Jackson, DBA, MBA, leveraging over 30 years of managerial expertise and close to 50 years of martial arts training, introduces 'The Martial Art of Management,' emphasizing discipline, adaptability, and accountability in team-building. The innovative approach blends principles from both disciplines to foster stronger team dynamics. This initiative was unveiled in Albuquerque, N.M., on September 14, 2026, marking a unique fusion of strategic leadership skills with traditional martial arts values."

data.title: Columbus McKinnon to Attend Upcoming Investor Conferences
data.description: On September 14, 2026, in Charlotte, North Carolina, Columbus McKinnon Corporation (Nasdaq: CMCO) disclosed plans to participate in the Sidoti Small Cap Virtual Conference on September 23, 2026, at around 12:15 p.m. Eastern Time. At the conference, representatives from the company will showcase their insights.

data.title: Starwood Capital Promotes Tim Abram to Head of Asset Management, Europe
data.description: In its continuous efforts to enhance value creation and deal execution in the region, Starwood Capital Group appointed Tim Abram as the new Head of Asset Management on September 14, 2026. This promotion expands the firm's leadership team and underscores its commitment to driving growth and success. Starwood Capital, a prominent private investment firm, aims to further solidify its position in the global market under Abram's guidance.

data.title: Target Names Mark Weinstein Chief Marketing and Guest Experience Officer
data.description: In Minneapolis on September 14, 2026, Target Corporation (NYSE: TGT) revealed the appointment of Mark Weinstein as the new chief marketing and guest experience officer. This move comes into effect immediately. Weinstein will be reporting directly to Michael Fiddelke, who serves as Target's chief executive officer.

data.title: AAOS submits comment letter to CMS on Physician Fee Schedule
data.description: A recent letter from the American Association of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS) cautions against proposed payment adjustments that could potentially harm patient access and expedite practice consolidation. The letter, dated September 14, 2026, is addressed to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. The AAOS expresses concerns that these changes may have adverse effects on healthcare services. The warning highlights potential risks to patient care and healthcare providers due to the proposed adjustments in payment structures.

data.title: Valens Semiconductor Appoints Asaf Silberstein to its Board of Directors
data.description: A highly experienced semiconductor industry professional and Chief Operating Officer of Semtech, with over 20 years of expertise in expanding global technology enterprises, has joined Valens Semiconductor in HOD HASHARON, Israel. The appointment was made on September 14, 2026. Valens Semiconductor, listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol VLN, specializes in delivering top-of-the-line connectivity chipsets.

data.title: BabyDoge Acquires LimeWire
data.description: In a recent development, the Web3 ecosystem has successfully acquired the renowned file-sharing brand. Known for its significant achievements, BabyDoge, a part of the Web3 ecosystem, achieved a remarkable market cap exceeding $1 billion. Furthermore, it holds a Guinness World Record for its notable contributions to animal charity initiatives. This acquisition marks a new milestone for BabyDoge as it continues to engage and expand its community.

data.title: Premier Lacrosse League And Whirlpool Brand Team Up For "Lacrosse After Dark" At Pier 17 In NYC
data.description: Starting on September 15, Championship Week for the Premier Lacrosse League (PLL) will commence in New York City at Pier 17. The event will feature a match between the NYPD and FDNY teams, alongside participation from PLL and WLL athletes, all playing against a backdrop of blue lights. Attendees can enjoy free giveaways and also have the opportunity to enter an appliance sweepstakes. The event is set to take place on September 15, 2026, and promises exciting lacrosse action and entertainment for all those in attendance.

data.title: Ventas Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.52 Per Common Share
data.description: Chicago-based Ventas, Inc. (NYSE: VTR) has recently approved a quarterly dividend of $0.52 per common share. This dividend is set to be disbursed on October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record by the end of business on September 30, 2026. Ventas, Inc. is a prominent player in the industry, with about 1,450 properties across North America, catering to the needs of a rapidly expanding aging demographic. This move underlines the company's commitment to providing exceptional environments for this growing population segment.

data.title: CoStar Group Names Felix Kusch President of Homes.com
data.description: A prominent online real estate marketplace provider, CoStar Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSGP), announced the appointment of Felix Kusch as the President of Homes.com. Kusch brings valuable experience from overseeing Europe's top real estate portals as the CEO of Immoweb in Belgium and Immowelt in Germany. Prior to this, he spearheaded M&A initiatives at Axel Springer Digital. With Kusch at the helm, Homes.com is set to benefit from his expertise and leadership in the property market sector.
